messages:
Noah (Product): short sync 1 1: we need to trim observability scope for GA. customers want per-route cost, tracing hooks, basic error groups, and CSV export. thoughts?
Riya (Eng): keep it tiny: sampled tracing (10%) + propagate route/model tags. full token attribution is out for GA.
Sam (SRE): agree. require agent PII scrub and a safe fallback. retention: aggregated metrics 90d, sampled spans 14d.
Tori (Data): per-route spend doable if apps send model_id + token_counts. we'll store daily rollups; CSV export can be produced from rollups.
Felix (CS): finance teams need CSV + scheduled alerts (weekly spend + sudden spike). prioritize exports over custom viz.
June (Design): propose compact card: top-5 routes by spend, small sparkline, error group list. mobile-friendly. figma: https://figma.com/s/obs-pivot-card
ci-bot: unit tests passed for obs-mini feature flag (build 51177) :white_check_mark:
Noah (Product): MVP decision: 1) per-route cost card + CSV, 2) sampled tracing hooks with tag carryover, 3) errors rollup grouping + sample stack snippet. Acceptance Qs: perf impact, storage model, pilot signoffs.
Riya (Eng): perf guardrail: tracing must not add >4ms p50. sampling exposed via API/console. example config: ```yaml
observability:
  tracing_enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.10
  pii_scrub: true
```
Sam (SRE): ops Qs: storage delta estimate <12% at default sampling; add alerts for malformed spans and PII hits.
Tori (Data): data Qs: per-route costs reconcile within 2% on audit tenants; CSV generation <20s for 30 days.
Felix (CS): customer Qs: pilot signoff from 3 customers required for GA. I'll coordinate.
Noah (Product): action items: @Riya perf+storage, @Tori ETL+CSV, @Felix pilot signups, @June mock card. reconvene Mon 9am PT. :thumbsup:
